description:
* Serve as the primary communication bridge between Korean clients and internal project teams on all project-related matters.
* Analyze, clarify, and accurately translate client requirements into actionable tasks for development teams.
* Manage and maintain all project documentation and materials to ensure consistency and accuracy.
* Collaborate closely with the Delivery team and Sales team to monitor progress, control quality, and ensure timely delivery of projects.
* Conduct testing and quality checks when necessary to support successful project outcomes.

[Required]
* Bachelor’s degree.
* At least 1 year of experience in translating/interpreting within the IT domain.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in Korean (TOPIK Level 5 or higher).
* Self-motivated, eager to learn business domains, software engineering, and languages.
* High sense of responsibility and strong teamwork spirit.
[Preferred]
* Experience in project management, business analysis (BA), or software testing.
